en: O He the wonders of whose mightiness will never end!
Bless Muhammad and his Household
and prevent us from deviation concerning Thy mightiness!

ar: وَيَا مَنْ لاَ تَنْتَهِي مُدَّةُ مُلْكِهِ،
en: O He the term of whose kingdom will never cease!
Bless Muhammad and his Household
and release our necks from Thy vengeance!

ar: وَيَا مَنْ لا تَفْنَى خَزَائِنُ رَحْمَتِهِ،
en: O He the treasuries of whose mercy will never be exhausted!
Bless Muhammad and his Household
and appoint for us a portion of Thy mercy!

ar: وَيَا مَنْ تَنْقَطِعُ دُونَ رُؤْيَتِهِ الابْصَارُ،
en: O He whom eyes fall short of seeing!
Bless Muhammad and his Household
and bring us close to Thy nearness!

ar: وَيَا مَنْ تَصْغُرُ عِنْدَ خَطَرِهِ الاخْطَارُ،
en: O He before whose greatness all great things are small!
Bless Muhammad and his Household
and give us honour with Thee!

ar: وَيَا مَنْ تَظْهَرُ عِنْدَهُ بَوَاطِنُ الاخْبَارِ،
en: O He to whom all hidden tidings are manifest!
Bless Muhammad and his Household
and expose us not before Thee!

ar: اللَّهُمَّ أَغْنِنَا عَنْ هِبَةِ الْوَهّابِيْنَ بِهِبَتِكَ،
en: O God, remove our need for the gifts of the givers through Thy gift,
spare us the loneliness of those who break off through Thy joining,

ar: حَتّى لا نَرْغَبَ إلَى أحَد مَعَ بَذْلِكَ،
en: that we may beseech no one along with Thy free giving,

ar: وَلاَ نَسْتَوْحِشَ مِنْ أحَد مَعَ فَضْلِكَ
en: that we may feel lonely at no one's absence along with Thy bounty!
O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
scheme for us, not against us,
devise to our benefit, not to our loss,
give the turn to prevail to us, not to others!
O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,

ar: وَقِنَا مِنْكَ، وَاحْفَظْنَا بِكَ، وَاهْدِنَا إلَيْكَ،
en: protect us from Thyself, safeguard us through Thyself, guide us to Thyself,

ar: وَلاَ تُبَاعِدْنَا عَنْكَ إنّ مَنْ تَقِهِ يَسْلَمْ،
en: and take us not far from Thyself! he whom Thou protectest stays safe,

ar: وَمَنْ تَهْدِهِ يَعْلَمْ، وَمَنْ تُقَرِّبُهُ إلَيْكَ يَغْنَمْ.
en: he whom Thou guidest knows, and he whom Thou bringest near Thyself takes the spoils.
O God, bless Muhammad and his Household
and spare us the cutting edge of time's turning changes,

ar: وَشَرَّ مَصَائِدِ الشّيطانِ وَمَرَارَةَ صَوْلَةِ السُّلْطَانِ.
en: the evil of Satan's snares, and the bitterness of the sovereign's aggression!
O God, the spared are spared only through the bounty
of Thy strength, so bless Muhammad and his Household, and spare us!

ar: وَإنَّمَا يُعْطِي الْمُعْطُونَ مِنْ فَضْلِ جِدَتِكَ
en: The givers give only through the bounty of Thy wealth,

ar: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ و اعطنا
en: so bless Muhammad and his Household and give to us!
The guided are guided only by the light of Thy face,
so bless Muhammad and his Household and guide us!

ar: اللّهُمَّ إنّكَ مَنْ وَالَيْتَ لَمْ يَضْرُرْهُ خِذْلانُ الْخَاذِلِينَ،
en: O God, he whom Thou befriendest will not be injured by the abandonment of the abandoners,

ar: وَمَنْ أعْطَيْتَ لَمْ يَنْقُصْهُ مَنْـعُ الْمَانِعِينَ،
en: he to whom Thou givest will not be diminished by the withholding of the withholders,

ar: وَمَنْ هَدَيْتَ لَمْ يُغْوِهِ إضْلاَلُ المُضِلِّيْنَ.
en: he whom Thou guidest will not be misled by the misguidance of the misguiders.

ar: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ، وَامْنَعْنَا بِعِزَّكَ، مِنْ عِبَادِكَ
en: So bless Muhammad and his Household, defend us from Thy servants
through Thy might, free us from need for other than Thee through Thy support,
and make us travel the path of the Truth through Thy right guidance!

ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِـهِ وَاجْعَلْ سَلاَمَةَ قُلُوبِنَا
en: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household and put the soundness of our hearts

ar: فِي ذِكْرِ عَظَمَتِكَ وَفَرَاغَ أبْدَانِنَا فِي شُكْرِ نِعْمَتِكَ
en: into the remembrance of Thy mightiness, the idleness of our bodies into giving thanks for Thy favour,
and the flow of our tongues into the description of Thy kindness!
O God, bless Muhammad and his Household
and make us one of Thy summoners who summon to Thee,
Thy guiders who direct to Thee,
and Thy special friends whom Thou hast singled out!
O Most Merciful of the merciful!
